suspicious_ocr_examples: Handrails and grab bars that require full grip shall have a round cross-section with a diameter of 1 3/16” (30 mm) to 1 37/64” (40 mm).

Shall a sign protrude into a sidewalk/walkway or route, a minimum vertical clearance of 2200m shall be provided. Obstacles, projections, or other protrusions shall be avoided in pedestrian areas such as sidewalks/walkways, halls, corridors, passageways or aisles. Pedestrians with visual disabilities often travel using the edge of the building line, hence, objects mounted on walls, posts, or sides of buildings, shall therefore not protrude more than 100 mm into sidewalks/walkways and corridors.

- 4. Escalators. Warning tactile blocks shall be installed on the terminating ﬂoor ﬁnish preceding the escalator’s metal landing plate. The warning tactile blocks shall have a depth of 600 mm and span the width of the escalator.

1. The tactile path to the accessible toilets shall lead to the tactile information map, etc., on the wall at the accessible toilet’s entrance/exit. Warning tactile blocks shall be installed 300 mm in front of the tactile information map.

1. At least one (1) public information/service counters for cinemas, theaters, concert halls, stadiums, museums, theme parks, purpose-built family amusement centers, sports complexes, public swimming pools, hospitals, clinics, transport stations, interchanges, and passenger terminals.
